cases.explain: The preposition "в" (in) governs the prepositional case for location.
Весть is the direct object after the verb "вернется", so accusative.

reading.ru: Слушайте мне, острова, внимайте, народы издалека.
reading.question: To whom does the Lord speak?
reading.explain: "Слушайте мне, острова, внимайте, народы издалека" — Listen to Me, islands, pay attention, distant peoples.

reading.question: When did the Lord call the servant?
reading.explain: "Еще утробе вызвал Мне Господь" — From the womb the Lord called Me.

reading.question: What does God say about restoration of Israel?
options: It is too small in My eyes compared to My greater plans
It is all I plan to do
reading.correct: It is too small in My eyes compared to My greater plans
reading.explain: God indicates His plans for salvation extend beyond Israel to all peoples.

reading.question: What kind of salvation does God bring to Israel?

reading.ru: Я даю спасение Сиону и славу мою Израилю.
reading.question: What does God grant?
options: Salvation to Zion and His glory to Israel
reading.correct: Salvation to Zion and His glory to Israel
reading.explain: "Я даю спасение Сиону и славу мою Израилю" — I give salvation to Zion and my glory to Israel.

reading.question: Who saves Israel?
reading.explain: "Я Господь спасу" — I, the Lord, will save.
